faces.name: New Coopenna
faces.oracleText:
When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, create three 1/1 white Pigeon creature tokens with flying.
Whenever chaos ensues, Pigeons you control gain annihilator 2 until end of turn. (Whenever a Pigeon you control attacks, defending player sacrifices two permanents of their choice.)
